name: neuroscience-datasets
author: lrgthu
description: Curated, citation-verified knowledge base of 112+ neuroscience datasets across 8 species and 19 modalities for NeuroAI, brain encoding/decoding, BCI, population dynamics, and connectomics, with zero-latency CLI search, leakage/pitfall guards, and verified auto-backfill.
suggestedPrompts: Compare human 7T fMRI, MEG/EEG, and macaque electrophysiology datasets sharing natural image or video stimuli, and check their test-split leakage pitfalls
Find open multi-area Neuropixels or 2-photon datasets for studying representational drift and latent population geometry, and output verified BibTeX keys
Audit our NeuroAI experiment plan against the Neuroscience Datasets Knowledge Base for confound traps, noise-ceiling formulas, and foundation-model pretraining overlap
